## What and why

What does this change, and why? Write "Closes #123" for each issue it resolves.

## How it was tested

What did you run or try by hand? For anything you can see, add a screenshot or a short recording.

## AI

Which AI tool helped, if any, and with what?

## Checklist

- [ ] I can explain every line of this change without asking an AI.
- [ ] `mise run lint` and `mise run test` pass.
- [ ] A test covers the new or fixed behavior.
- [ ] The title is a conventional commit title, such as `fix(ui): ...`.
